shellCommands.command: find /workspace/app -type f | head -30; echo "---"; cat /workspace/lib/data.ts; echo "---LAYOUT"; cat /workspace/app/layout.tsx; echo "---PAGE"; cat /workspace/app/page.tsx
ls node_modules/.bin 2>/dev/null | head -5; echo "---"; cat node_modules/next/package.json 2>/dev/null | grep '"version"'; echo "---git"; git log --oneline -3; git diff package.json

ls /workspace/.next/server/app/product* 2>/dev/null; echo "=== prerendered shell ==="; grep -o '

[^<]*

\|Loading inventory[^<]*\|in stock' /workspace/.next/server/app/product.html 2>/dev/null

(npx next start -p 3111 >/tmp/next.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 6; echo "=== served HTML ==="; curl -s http://localhost:3111/product | grep -o '

[^<]*

\|Loading inventory[^<]*\|[0-9]* in stock\|Price: \$[0-9.]*'; pkill -f "next start" 2>/dev/null; true
pgrep -f "next start" >/dev/null && echo "still running" || echo "server stopped"; git diff --stat
pkill -9 -f "next-server" ; pkill -9 -f "next start" ; sleep 1; pgrep -f "next" >/dev/null && echo "still running" || echo "server stopped"
